strategy.scope: Buyer food discovery; current Shop capacity policy remains
strategy.scan: All order-eligible stocked shop/SKU pairs ranked locally against bounded cached evidence; no live full-market price scan
strategy.public_food_sample: 15-minute cache/settlement age, >=2 distinct orders and buyers in same shop/SKU/grade, honest claim, unambiguous identities, synced market clock
strategy.local_selection: Targets at or below 60% of list (lower budget-derived target takes priority); 20% deterministic exploration retained
strategy.eligibility: Food A/B/C; certificate required; remaining lifetime >= use_within_hours + 1h
strategy.separation: Expiry-unverified discovery is selection only, never negotiation price_reference or payment authorization
strategy.calls: No additional network/model calls; eligible local choice skips selection model; existing max two shops and four shared decisions
